cohort: 72 members of the Korean Society of Maternal and Fetal Medicine.
finding: The majority of Korean Society of Maternal and Fetal Medicine members believe that labour induction at late-preterm to early-term gestation decreases perinatal morbidity in cases of isolated oligohydramnios.
mod_finding: The majority of Korean Society of Maternal and Fetal Medicine members believe that isolated oligohydramnios is a risk factor for caesarean delivery.
